decision_gate.core_failure_definition: A repetition has a core failure when any zero-based criterion index listed in that case's core_criteria is false in the completed blind review.

efficiency.semantics: Promptfoo recorded totals for this run only; percent = comparison/reference - 1.

analysis.discrimination_note: The current and upstream skills were perfect on all frozen criteria; baseline missed one source-scope criterion. This near-ceiling sample does not establish broad superiority, and no preregistered mechanism opened a local candidate design.

decision.conclusion: Keep product-context-brief 0.1.0 unchanged. The current skill and fixed upstream both reached the ceiling on this sample, baseline missed one criterion, and no mechanism met the preregistered candidate gate.

limitations: Six synthetic single-turn Chinese read-only product-context tasks, one generation model, one reasoning effort, and three repetitions per arm.
The anonymous reviewer was model-assisted rather than an independent human; blindness covered randomized arm mapping and the reviewer reported respecting the requested file boundary.
A second model-assisted reviewer checked only the single false judgment after reveal; identity knowledge may bias calibration, and true judgments were not independently re-audited.
The common prompt narrowed upstream product-marketing to its shared one-shot text organization slice; this report does not rank its full discovery, collaboration, versioning, or save workflow.
Explicit invocation produced no required skill-call trace, so the run does not prove that every ours or upstream trajectory loaded its package instructions.
No implicit routing, real release or authorization system, file write, multi-turn collaboration, customer study, or marketing outcome was tested.
Raw Promptfoo artifacts remain git-ignored; the public report embeds synthetic outputs, scores, calibration, and hashes, but a fresh clone cannot independently recreate provider events.
